questions.prompt: From the center out, what are the four layers of a coaxial cable?
options: Metal shield, inner conductor, plastic jacket, insulating material
Glass core, cladding, metal shield, plastic jacket
Inner conductor, metal shield, insulating material, plastic jacket
Inner conductor, insulating material, metal shield, plastic jacket

questions.prompt: Which plastic is usually used for coax's insulating material? (one word)
What does coax's metal shield do?
options: Blocks outside noise from reaching the signal and keeps the signal inside

questions.prompt: The outer plastic jacket also helps protect people from electric shock.

options: Many signals over long distances using modulation
One digital signal over a short distance, with no modulation

questions.prompt: Cable TV and cable Internet share one coax line into your home. Which kind of coax is that?
Broadband coax gives each signal its own frequency channel. What's that technique called? Give its three-letter abbreviation.
Baseband coax has only one channel, so devices take turns in slices of time. What's that called? Give its three-letter abbreviation.
Broadband coax represents data as analog waves on carrier frequencies, while baseband sends digital signals directly.
Baseband coax has more bandwidth than broadband, because it doesn't waste effort on modulation.
